meta.title: How we deliver: use-case sprints, proof before scale
meta.description: How Viewnear delivers on Snowflake: use-case-driven sprints, proof before scale, and engagement governance, with fixed timelines, steering reviews, POC gates, and a clean handover.

hero.title: Delivery leaders can <hl>govern</hl>.
hero.description: Use-case-driven sprints with working software at every demo, plus the governance that de-risks the engagement itself, so sponsors always know where the work stands.

experience.title: What an engagement feels like from the sponsor's seat
experience.intro: The reviews the sponsor runs, the demos the team watches, and the decisions that stay in-house: one engagement, from the first scoping session to handover.

run.title: Checkpoints sponsors control
run.intro: Clear timelines, steering, and a clean handover: the questions every sponsor asks, answered up front.

runPhases.title: A fixed 8–16 week arc
runPhases.body: Most initial builds reach production in 8–16 weeks: a discovery fixes scope and price up front, and every sprint closes with working software, so value lands from sprint one.

runPhases.title: Steering & transparency
runPhases.body: Regular steering reviews, a shared backlog, and clear decision gates keep sponsors in control of scope, budget, and priorities throughout.

runPhases.title: Proof before scale
runPhases.body: We prove the approach with a focused proof of concept before the full build, so the commitment to scale rests on evidence, not a slide deck.

runPhases.title: Built to hand over
runPhases.body: Runbooks, documentation, and enablement sessions ship with the build, plus a transition plan that names who runs what when we step back.

impact.title: What changes, and when
impact.intro: A practical view of the value an engagement returns, by horizon, not by feature list.

impactByPhase.title: Foundations & first value
impactByPhase.body: A governed foundation on Snowflake stood up, priority data flowing, and the first production dashboards live: the data practice takes root.

impactByPhase.title: Scale & self-service
impactByPhase.body: Analytics and AI use cases rolled out across teams; self-service adopted and manual reporting retired.

impactByPhase.title: Compounding advantage
impactByPhase.body: New use cases shipped in weeks, run cost tuned, and a team fluent enough to keep extending it on their own.
